rationale: Ground truth carries no substantive concerns (bare 'lgtm' + a bot notice), so recall is vacuous for both. Both candidates independently surface the same real, well-grounded defect: pure-diffusion mode sets serving_tokenization=None while _create_speech_error_json_response still dereferences base(raw_request) unguarded, meaning the PR's fix is incomplete for diffusion servers — both back this with correct file/line evidence and concrete patches. X extends further into speculative territory (Dockerfile vLLM-pin sleuthing, sibling openai_serving_* rename audit) that is honestly hedged but unverifiable from the diff; Y catches an additional plausible bug (bare ErrorResponse returned with implicit 200 instead of 404 in create_chat_completion) and uses a more disciplined evidence/validate methodology, though a couple of its 'findings' (CI selection, stale comment) are informational rather than actionable fixes. Both are highly actionable with inline suggestions; overall quality is comparable enough to call it a slight tie leaning Y for the extra verified bug.
